This confirms the previous note that kitchen_table_k1 is the likely late afternoon/evening spot. The error at 14:18 suggests coffee_table_l1 is the likely afternoon spot, not desk_b1. Next time: Check coffee_table_l1 for afternoon queries (12:00-16:00) and kitchen_table_k1 for late afternoon/evening queries (after 16:00). Avoid desk_b1 for these timeframes.
